about.title: Your Reliable Hydraulics Partner
about.intro: AquaDrive Hydraulics specializes in supplying high-quality hydraulic pumps, travel motors and parts for excavators. For over 15 years we have served construction and mining customers worldwide, with a strong focus on the African market.
about.mission: We help equipment dealers, repair workshops and mining companies keep their excavators running. Every pump is matched carefully to your machine and tested before shipment.
about.v1_desc: Genuine-spec materials and full-pressure testing on every unit.
about.v2_desc: Clear warranty, accurate fitment advice, no empty promises.
about.v3_desc: We understand African ports, logistics and payment realities.
